database_summary: This is a retail-like analytical schema in SQLite containing customer, product, promotion, channel and time dimension-like tables; fact/event tables for sales and costs; supplemental demographic and currency reference tables. Times is a calendar/fiscal date dimension. Customers, products, promotions, channels and countries hold descriptive attributes (dimensions). Sales and costs are event/measurement facts at a product-customer-time(-channel,promo) grain. Row counts show a large sales fact (~919k) and smaller facts for costs (~82k) and dimensions (customers 55k, products 24, promotions 503, times 1.8k). Foreign keys are declared from facts to dimensions (sales -> times, products, customers, channels, promotions; costs -> times, products, channels, promotions).

accepted.name: sales_base
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  prod_id AS prod_id,
  cust_id AS cust_id,
  time_id AS time_id,
  channel_id AS channel_id,
  promo_id AS promo_id,
  COALESCE(quantity_sold, 0) AS quantity_sold,
  COALESCE(amount_sold, 0.0) AS amount_sold
FROM sales
accepted.description: Canonicalized sales event rows with deterministic column names and NULL-safe casts. Use this as the normalized sales fact for joins, aggregations, and time-based analysis. | Use for: Total sales (amount/quantity) by product/customer/time/channel/promo; Filtering or joining sales to dimensions; Time series aggregations, cohort definitions on sales events

accepted.name: sales_by_time_product_channel
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  time_id AS time_id,
  prod_id AS prod_id,
  channel_id AS channel_id,
  SUM(COALESCE(quantity_sold, 0)) AS total_quantity_sold,
  SUM(COALESCE(amount_sold, 0.0)) AS total_amount_sold
FROM sales
GROUP BY time_id, prod_id, channel_id
accepted.description: Aggregated sales measures at the (time_id, prod_id, channel_id) grain: total quantity and total amount. Useful for time-series product/channel analysis and joins to times/products/channels. | Use for: Daily/monthly sales per product and channel; Calculating margins when joined with costs; Identifying high/low performing product-channel combinations over time

accepted.name: costs_base
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  prod_id AS prod_id,
  time_id AS time_id,
  promo_id AS promo_id,
  channel_id AS channel_id,
  unit_cost AS unit_cost,
  unit_price AS unit_price
FROM costs
accepted.description: Normalized costs rows with NULL-safe unit measures at their native grain (prod_id, time_id, promo_id, channel_id). Use for joins to sales aggregates to compute margin or blended unit costs. | Use for: Unit cost/price lookup for a product by time/channel/promo; Join with sales to compute gross margin or cost of goods sold

accepted.name: customers_active
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  cust_id AS cust_id,
  cust_first_name AS cust_first_name,
  cust_last_name AS cust_last_name,
  cust_gender AS cust_gender,
  cust_year_of_birth AS cust_year_of_birth,
  cust_marital_status AS cust_marital_status,
  cust_city AS cust_city,
  cust_state_province AS cust_state_province,
  country_id AS country_id,
  cust_main_phone_number AS cust_main_phone_number,
  cust_income_level AS cust_income_level,
  cust_credit_limit AS cust_credit_limit,
  cust_email AS cust_email,
  cust_eff_from AS cust_eff_from,
  cust_eff_to AS cust_eff_to,
  cust_valid AS cust_valid
FROM customers
WHERE cust_valid = 'A' OR cust_valid IS NULL
accepted.description: Subset of customer rows that are likely active/current. Preserves customer identifying and demographic attributes for joining to facts. Use when analyses should consider current/valid customers. | Use for: Demographic breakdowns of active customers; Joining active customers to sales to compute customer-level metrics; Customer-retention or life-time-value calculations restricted to active customers

accepted.name: products_current
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  prod_id AS prod_id,
  prod_name AS prod_name,
  prod_desc AS prod_desc,
  prod_subcategory AS prod_subcategory,
  prod_subcategory_id AS prod_subcategory_id,
  prod_subcategory_desc AS prod_subcategory_desc,
  prod_category AS prod_category,
  prod_category_id AS prod_category_id,
  prod_weight_class AS prod_weight_class,
  prod_unit_of_measure AS prod_unit_of_measure,
  prod_pack_size AS prod_pack_size,
  supplier_id AS supplier_id,
  prod_status AS prod_status,
  prod_list_price AS prod_list_price,
  prod_min_price AS prod_min_price,
  prod_eff_from AS prod_eff_from,
  prod_eff_to AS prod_eff_to,
  prod_valid AS prod_valid
FROM products
WHERE prod_valid = 'A' OR prod_valid IS NULL
accepted.description: Current/active product rows based on prod_valid flag. Use when analyses should use recently valid product attributes. | Use for: Price/book value joins to sales; Product attribute analysis for active products; Filtering sales to current product catalog

accepted.name: sales_enriched
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.prod_id AS prod_id,
  s.cust_id AS cust_id,
  s.time_id AS time_id,
  s.channel_id AS channel_id,
  s.promo_id AS promo_id,
  COALESCE(s.quantity_sold, 0) AS quantity_sold,
  COALESCE(s.amount_sold, 0.0) AS amount_sold,
  t.calendar_year AS calendar_year,
  t.calendar_month_desc AS calendar_month_desc,
  p.prod_name AS prod_name,
  p.prod_category AS prod_category,
  c.cust_city AS cust_city,
  c.cust_state_province AS cust_state_province,
  ch.channel_desc AS channel_desc,
  pr.promo_name AS promo_name
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
LEFT JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
LEFT JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
LEFT JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
LEFT JOIN promotions pr ON s.promo_id = pr.promo_id
accepted.description: Denormalized sales rows joined to key dimensions (times, products, customers, channels, promotions). Exposes descriptive attributes alongside measures for flexible reporting. | Use for: Ad-hoc reporting requiring descriptive labels with sales measures; Pivoting sales by product/category/month/channel; Filtering by promotion or channel attributes

accepted.name: customer_demographics_enriched
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.cust_id AS cust_id,
  c.cust_first_name AS cust_first_name,
  c.cust_last_name AS cust_last_name,
  c.cust_gender AS cust_gender,
  c.cust_year_of_birth AS cust_year_of_birth,
  c.cust_city AS cust_city,
  sd.education AS education,
  sd.occupation AS occupation,
  sd.household_size AS household_size,
  sd.yrs_residence AS yrs_residence,
  sd.affinity_card AS affinity_card,
  sd.cricket AS cricket,
  sd.baseball AS baseball,
  sd.tennis AS tennis,
  sd.soccer AS soccer,
  sd.golf AS golf
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN supplementary_demographics sd ON c.cust_id = sd.cust_id
accepted.description: Customers joined to their supplementary demographics where available. One row per customer with demographic flags and attributes for segmentation. | Use for: Customer segmentation using demographics and affinity flags; Joining demographics to purchase behavior

accepted.name: time_calendar_month
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  calendar_year AS calendar_year,
  calendar_month_desc AS calendar_month_desc,
  MIN(time_id) AS month_start_date,
  MAX(time_id) AS month_end_date
FROM times
GROUP BY calendar_year, calendar_month_desc
accepted.description: Times summarized at calendar month (calendar_year, calendar_month_desc) with month-level identifiers. Useful for rolling up daily facts to months. | Use for: Monthly time buckets for aggregations; Mapping dates to month labels for reports

accepted.name: country_lookup
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  country_id AS country_id,
  country_iso_code AS country_iso_code,
  country_name AS country_name,
  country_subregion AS country_subregion,
  country_subregion_id AS country_subregion_id,
  country_region AS country_region,
  country_region_id AS country_region_id
FROM countries
accepted.description: Canonical country reference preserving ISO code and descriptive fields for joins to customers or other country-level analyses. | Use for: Geographic rollups and joins from customers to country attributes; Filtering or grouping sales/customers by region or ISO code

accepted.name: sales_monthly_product
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.calendar_year AS calendar_year,
  t.calendar_month_desc AS calendar_month_desc,
  s.prod_id AS prod_id,
  SUM(COALESCE(s.quantity_sold, 0)) AS total_quantity_sold,
  SUM(COALESCE(s.amount_sold, 0.0)) AS total_amount_sold
FROM sales s
JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
GROUP BY t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_desc, s.prod_id
accepted.description: Monthly aggregated sales at the product level (calendar_year + calendar_month_desc + prod_id) producing total quantity and amount. Use for trending and month-over-month calculations. | Use for: Monthly product performance reports; Time-series forecasting inputs at product-month grain

accepted.name: currency_rates_by_month
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  year AS year,
  month AS month,
  AVG(COALESCE(to_us, 1.0)) AS avg_to_us
FROM currency
GROUP BY year, month
accepted.description: Monthly average currency conversion rates to USD per (year, month) preserving the 'to_us' rate. Useful for converting historical amounts when joining with monthly aggregates. | Use for: Currency conversion of historical sales aggregated by month; Joining average monthly FX to monthly financials
